source.title: Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents?
source.text: More than 40 projects are working to bring a leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 to PC through reverse engineering just days after its $3.79 billion record console launch. AI coding agents like Claude Code are speeding up the process so much that an early unofficial multiplayer mode is already running. Rockstar's delayed PC business model is coming under pressure. The article Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents? appeared first on The Decoder .

draft.headline: More than 40 community projects are using AI coding agents to reverse engineer a leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 to PC.
draft.threads_post:
More than 40 projects are using AI coding agents to port a leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 to PC through reverse engineering.

Developers are using tools like Claude Code to accelerate the work. An unofficial multiplayer mode is already running, just days after the game's record $3.79 billion console launch.

This puts heavy pressure on Rockstar's traditional model of staggering PC releases.

Will AI force game studios to launch on PC day one?

Rockstar has historically relied on a staggered release model, delaying PC versions well after console launches. Now, AI-assisted community efforts are putting that business model under serious pressure.
